title: Art. 13.1 — Annex 6 Part I - Operation of Aircraft: International Commercial Air Transport - Aeroplanes, Chapter 13, Article 13.1 - Security of domestic commercial operations, 13.1
content:
13.1 Domestic commercial operations

13.1.1 When an operator conducts domestic commercial operations, the operator shall comply with the security provisions established by the State in which those operations are conducted.
